question: What destination is attained by one whose self is purified of all sin?
premises: The subject's self is purified of all sin.
The subject is the same realized one previously indicated.
A specific destination, the world of Śiva, is named.
inference: One purified of all sin goes to the world of Śiva.
plain_english: With a self purified of all sins, he goes to the world of Śiva.
